G10a-3 S7 (rec/writer.js, PR 1 of 3; lane A), on main c5d5ad4 (lane B's S8/S9 merged): v2 writes compound and x/2 bars exactly and brackets its tuplet beats itself (classes 3/5/6/7 of v2 rows -> 0), a triplet-16th grid kind '6' (rec.tuplet.recall up), notation-check class 3 by the bar's metre (legacy/app MusicXML unchanged; their rec.check.3 moves on 6/8 and 12/8 bars only), classes 2/7 accept triplet-16th brackets, arrangements of v2 recordings re-bracket half beats. Moved the wrong way, with cause (G10 section 24.5): false tuplet beats +0.2-0.3 per 100 beats pooled, tuplet precision -0.006 to -0.008 (the '6' kind on unsure or wrong skeletons), feature:ottava (Czerny 849 008/011/019/020) durations -0.011 to -0.018, micro M05/M06 32nd runs read as sixths, one critical.key flip (Czerny 849/013). rec-full also takes lane B's S8/S9 (its baseline was not re-recorded with them: key +0.013, pedal +0.029, book:burgmuller25 key -0.034)

G10a-3 S6 (rec/rests.js silence classifier, AI-5b; PR 2 of 3, on PR 1): a silence of an eighth or more between two notes of a voice is a rest only when the model says so (v2 only; hold-out decision accuracy 0.198 -> 0.843). v2 rows gain usable, rec.usable, note values, duration accuracy, rest precision, false rests, stability, MV2H (G10 section 24.6). Moved the wrong way, with cause: rec.rest.recall -0.05 to -0.24 (accuracy-optimal decisions call unclear silences legato; rest-rich etudes under the pedal profiles lose them, a few Burgmueller cases lose critical.note_values), replay-public-v2 extra ties 0 -> 8.8 per 100 notes (two fixtures whose bar lines the skeleton misplaces: legato notes tied over them), rec-arrange arr.lh.notes_per_bar +0.06 to +0.23 and hymns' arr.level.distinct -0.011 (fewer false rests leave more held notes to arrange), single values on micro M10/M16/M17/M19/M20/M22/M23 rows

G10a-3 S5 (rec/voices.js, PR 3 of 3, on PR 2): two voices per staff for four-part writing (S4's chorale style), each with its own durations and rests; a part's silence while the other part sounds is legato by rule (S6, not trained on); rec.rest rec/2 counts staff silences (rest spans minus sounding notes of the staff; identical for one-voice staff-bars). Gains: rec.voice.f1, rest precision, rec.usable, usable, pitch integrity, MV2H (G10 section 24.7-24.8). Moved the wrong way, with cause: replay-of-v2 duration accuracy -0.028 and extra ties +2.4/100 (two voices hold a part over an AMT-merged or missed repeat), Burgmueller 023 split where its edition has one voice (book voice F1 -0.01 to -0.03), rec-arrange hymns melody kept -0.02 / harmony -0.025 / level distinct -0.026 and left-hand density +0.11 (the arranger on two parts per staff, G10c), rec-grid v2-s3legacy compound class 5 0.18 -> 0.25 (that arm only; v2 rows 0), small rest-precision drops on set:micro and mode:minor tags, single values on a few micro rows
